On the basis of consultation done, Authority notified revised regulatory framework on 1st December 2010, as Telecom Commercial Communications Customer Preference Regulations (TCCCPR-2010). 1.3 Revised Regulatory Framework notified in 2010 1.3.1 TCCCPR-2010 notified on 1st of December 2010 came into effect in a phased manner and were amended several times. Regulations 1 to 2 and 23 to 25 came into force on the date of notification, while a few (13 to 17) were supposed to come into effect on 15th Dec. 2010 and rest (3 to 12 and 18 to 22) were supposed to come into effect on 1st Jan. 2011. Dates of enforcement of some of these regulations were revised due to implementation issues, and with revised dates, all regulations came into force by 27th of November 2011.
